title: Design, synthesis, in silico and in vitro evaluation of pyrrole–indole hybrids as dual tubulin and aromatase inhibitors with potent anticancer activities
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,21962-21976
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA09000D, Paper
Open Access

Rungroj Saruengkhanphasit, Jaruwan Chatwichien, Lukana Ngiwsara, Kriengsak Lirdprapamongkol, Worawat Niwetmarin, Chatchakorn Eurtivong, Prasat Kittakoop, Jisnuson Svasti, Somsak Ruchirawat
The study introduces a new series of pyrrolyl-3-phenyl-1H-indole-2-carbohydrazide derivatives which were rationalized and designed as potent dual inhibitors of two oncologic targets, tubulin and aromatase.
